themes_detail.label: Street Sign Infrastructure Collapse
themes_detail.summary: Street sign damage complaints in Elmhurst/South Corona spiked to 11 this week—a 363% increase over the 8-week baseline average of 2.4 per week (z-score: 7.08)—suggesting possible weather damage, construction impact, or accelerated deterioration requiring urgent public safety review.
evidence: 11 street sign damage complaints filed THIS WEEK vs. 2.4 per week 8-week average
363% spike with z-score of 7.08 (high statistical significance)
Timing aligns with recent weather events or possible construction activity in district
reporting_angles: What triggered the sudden spike in damaged street signs—weather, accidents, or maintenance failures?
Are dangerous or missing traffic signs creating safety hazards for drivers and pedestrians?

themes_detail.label: Street Noise Complaint Surge
themes_detail.summary: Street and sidewalk noise complaints jumped to 44 THIS WEEK—a 229% spike over the 8-week baseline of 13.4 per week (z-score: 5.23)—pointing to possible new construction, street work, or vendor activity disrupting the neighborhood.
evidence: 44 noise-street/sidewalk complaints filed THIS WEEK vs. 13.4 per week baseline
229% increase with z-score of 5.23 (strong statistical significance)
Concurrent spike in 'Noise' general complaints: 16 THIS WEEK vs. 5.8 weekly average (178% increase)
reporting_angles: What new street or construction activity is generating the noise spike—and when will it end?
Are street vendors or late-night commercial activity responsible for the increase?

themes_detail.label: Hazardous Materials Alert
themes_detail.summary: Hazardous materials complaints spiked to 3 LAST WEEK—a 1100% increase over the 8-week baseline of 0.2 per week (z-score: 6.35)—indicating possible chemical spills, illegal dumping, or industrial discharge that requires immediate environmental and health investigation.
evidence: 3 hazardous materials complaints filed LAST WEEK vs. 0.2 per week 8-week average
1100% spike with z-score of 6.35 (severe statistical anomaly)
Suggests concentrated incident or ongoing contamination risk in specific location(s)
reporting_angles: What hazardous materials were reported, where, and by which businesses or facilities?
Is this a single incident or a pattern indicating systemic environmental violations?

themes_detail.label: Elevator System Failures Spike
themes_detail.summary: Elevator complaints jumped to 38 TWO WEEKS AGO—a 415% increase over the 8-week baseline of 7.4 per week (z-score: 7.66)—indicating widespread maintenance failures in residential buildings that may leave elderly and disabled residents stranded.
evidence: 38 elevator complaints TWO WEEKS AGO vs. 7.4 per week 8-week average
415% spike with z-score of 7.66 (high statistical severity)
Disproportionate impact on elderly, disabled, and families with children in multi-family buildings
reporting_angles: Which buildings have chronic elevator failures, and are landlords neglecting required maintenance?
How many residents are affected, and what safety risks exist during outages?

themes_detail.label: Vendor Enforcement Action Wave
themes_detail.summary: Vendor enforcement complaints spiked to 9 TWO WEEKS AGO—a 454% increase over the 8-week baseline of 1.6 per week (z-score: 4.93)—potentially indicating a new enforcement campaign, illegal vending activity, or vendor permit violations concentrated in specific commercial areas.
evidence: 9 vendor enforcement complaints TWO WEEKS AGO vs. 1.6 per week 8-week average
May reflect increased street vending, unpermitted commerce, or city enforcement blitz
reporting_angles: Is the city conducting a new vendor enforcement campaign in Elmhurst/South Corona?
Are street vendors complying with permits, or is illegal vending driving complaints?
